HINT: Switching to PIP-based convergence: R uncertainty inflation modifies per-variant SER likelihoods, which prevents a consistent model-level ELBO.
HINT: NIG prior integrates out residual variance, implying estimate_residual_variance = TRUE. Setting estimate_residual_variance = TRUE. To suppress this hint, explicitly set estimate_residual_variance = TRUE in the function call.
HINT: NIG method works better with EM. Setting estimate_prior_method='EM'.
